items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex trades flat, Nifty around 23,400; auto, IT shares underperform
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: The GIFT Nifty indicated that the Nifty50 may extend losses at open. Asian markets were trading lower

items.title: Hero Motors' ₹1000-crore IPO to open on Sept 16; price band at ₹79-₹84
items.description: The three-day IPO will open on September 16, with the auto parts maker planning to raise ₹600 crore through fresh shares and ₹400 crore through an offer for sale
